name: Mahtari Vandan Yojana
description: Financial empowerment programme by Government of Chhattisgarh providing monthly financial assistance to married women for nutrition and health security.
descriptionHindi: छत्तीसगढ़ सरकार द्वारा विवाहित महिलाओं के स्वास्थ्य, पोषण और आर्थिक स्वावलंबन हेतु मासिक सहायता योजना।
ministry: Women and Child Development Department, Chhattisgarh
benefits: Monthly financial aid of ₹1,000 (total ₹12,000 annually) transferred directly to the married woman's Aadhaar-linked bank account.
benefitsHindi: प्रति माह ₹1,000 (वार्षिक ₹12,000) की वित्तीय सहायता सीधे महिला के आधार लिंक बैंक खाते में।
eligibilityText: Married women (including widows, divorcees, abandoned) domiciled in Chhattisgarh who are 21 years of age or above as of January 1 of the application year.
eligibilityTextHindi: छत्तीसगढ़ की मूल निवासी 21 वर्ष या उससे अधिक आयु की विवाहित, विधवा या परित्यक्ता महिलाएं।
sourceName: Mahtari Vandan Portal, Government of Chhattisgarh
